summary.name: Pixmax
summary.one_liner: Pixmax is an all-in-one AI creative platform for generating videos, images, ads, and audio using multiple leading AI models in a canvas-based workspace.
use_cases: turn a script or screenplay into a storyboard and video
create AI images and short videos for ads
produce short dramas, animations, commercials, or game trailers
chain text, image, video, and audio generation in one project
collaborate with a team on AI video production
add voiceovers and captions to social-ready videos
summary.what_it_does: Pixmax provides access to video, image, text, and audio generation models in one workspace, so users do not need separate subscriptions or credits for each. Its visual workflow feature chains text, image, video, and audio tasks together as reusable, editable steps. An infinite canvas holds scripts, references, storyboards, and model settings. The script-to-video flow turns a pasted idea or screenplay into characters, scenes, and storyboard panels, which users can preview and tweak before exporting videos with voiceovers and captions. Saved assets such as characters, scenes, and brand styles can be reused, and pre-built templates are offered for common formats.
notable: Unified model hub that lets different video, image, text and audio models be used within one project
Infinite canvas and visual workflow for chaining generation steps
Script-to-video flow that auto-generates characters, scenes and storyboards
Pre-built templates for short dramas, animations, commercials and game trailers
caveats: Pricing tiers and credit limits are not detailed on the page; freemium status comes from the directory listing
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated
